recognize_zh: 周邊血液有一個中型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質淡藍且四周佈滿細毛狀突起（箭頭）；骨髓切片中則同時可見 PV 的大型分葉異常巨核細胞（實線箭頭）與間質中卵圓核的淋巴樣細胞浸潤（虛線箭頭），提示 PV 背景上發生毛狀細胞白血病變異型。
features: Panel A (PB): medium-to-large lymphoid cell with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and circumferential fine hairy projections (arrow)
Hairy cell nucleus round-oval with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleolus not clearly resolved at this magnification
Nearby small lymphocyte and scattered platelets; red cells with occasional target and stomatocytic forms
Panel B (BM biopsy H&E): hypercellular marrow with large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes (solid arrows) consistent with MPN
Interstitial infiltrate of cells with oval to bean-shaped nuclei and clear-to-pale cytoplasm (dashed arrows)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-to-large lymphoid cell with abundant pale blue cytoplasm bearing circumferential hairy projections (arrow) and a round-oval nucleus. The bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular and contains large, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes (solid arrows) consistent with the known JAK2 V617F-positive polycythemia vera, admixed with an interstitial infiltrate of lymphoid cells with oval nuclei and pale cytoplasm (dashed arrows). Morphology alone cannot distinguish classic hairy cell leukemia from its variant; flow cytometry (CD25/CD123/annexin A1 negativity in the variant), BRAF V600E testing and MAP2K1 analysis are required. Findings are consistent with a hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli) arising in a patient with polycythemia vera.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL has no prominent nucleolus, presents with monocytopenia, and is CD25+, CD123+, annexin A1+ and BRAF V600E mutated, whereas the variant is CD25−, annexin A1−, BRAF wild type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar villi, less abundant cytoplasm and a nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow pattern and are CD103 negative.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based villi and a predominantly intrasinusoidal marrow pattern; distinction from HCL-v relies on nucleolar prominence and immunophenotype and may be difficult.
Myelofibrosis shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes with reticulin fibrosis and leukoerythroblastosis but no clonal B-cell infiltrate with hairy projections.
